info.title: SQLab — SQL Learning & Practice Platform API

post.description: Called by the frontend every 60s while a tab is visible — real learning time.
Checked exactly like official exercises; generated practice gives no points (it is self-study).
Hand a seeded lesson back to content-as-code: the next seed restores the version in Git.
Dry run: execute the solution and return the expected result without saving.

Rebuild the template + shared read-only copy, then recompute expected results of every exercise on
it. Learners' writable sandboxes are not touched.
Measure a query, add the proposed index(es), measure again — on a throwaway copy, so nothing persists.
Stateless: validate + DDL for each dialect + Mermaid preview.
Reset the learner's writable `blank` DB and create the designed tables in it.
Mock interview: save the written explanation (sql field is ignored).
